name: Paneer Bhurji
ingredients: 200g Paneer (crumbled); 1 medium Onion (finely chopped); 1 medium Tomato (finely chopped); 1 green chili (chopped); 1/2 tsp Turmeric powder; 1/2 tsp Garam masala; 1 tbsp Oil or Butter; Salt to taste; Fresh coriander leaves for garnish
steps: Heat oil or butter in a pan over medium heat.; Add chopped onions and green chili. Sauté until onions become translucent.; Add chopped tomatoes and cook until they soften and turn mushy.; Stir in turmeric powder, garam masala, and salt. Cook for 1 minute.; Add crumbled paneer and mix well. Cook for 3-4 minutes, stirring constantly.; Garnish with chopped coriander leaves and serve hot with roti or bread.
description: A popular North Indian dish made with crumbled paneer (cottage cheese), onions, tomatoes, and spices. It's a quick, high-protein vegetarian breakfast or side dish.

name: Grilled Chicken
ingredients: 250g Chicken breast; 1 tbsp Olive oil; 1 tbsp Lemon juice; 2 cloves Garlic (minced); 1/2 tsp Black pepper; 1/2 tsp Paprika; Salt to taste; 1 cup Broccoli florets (for side)
steps: Clean the chicken breast and pat it dry with paper towels.; In a small bowl, mix olive oil, lemon juice, minced garlic, paprika, black pepper, and salt to create a marinade.; Coat the chicken breast evenly with the marinade. Let it sit for 10-15 minutes.; Preheat a grill pan or outdoor grill over medium-high heat.; Place the chicken on the grill and cook for 6-8 minutes on each side, or until the internal temperature reaches 165°F (74°C).; Steam the broccoli florets in a separate pot for 5 minutes.; Let the chicken rest for 3 minutes, slice it, and serve alongside steamed broccoli.
description: Lean chicken breast marinated in garlic, lemon, and spices, then grilled to juicy perfection. A classic low-carb, high-protein fitness meal.

name: Dal Rice
ingredients: 1 cup Yellow lentils (Toor Dal); 1 cup Brown rice; 1 tbsp Ghee; 1 tsp Cumin seeds; 2 cloves Garlic (chopped); 1 small Onion (chopped); 1/2 tsp Turmeric powder; 1/2 tsp Red chili powder; Salt to taste; Water as needed
steps: Wash the brown rice and yellow lentils separately.; Cook brown rice in a pot or rice cooker with 2.5 cups of water until soft.; In a pressure cooker, cook yellow lentils with 3 cups of water, turmeric powder, and salt for 3-4 whistles (or simmer in a pot for 25 mins).; For the tempering (tadka), heat ghee in a small pan.; Add cumin seeds and let them splutter. Add chopped garlic and onions, and sauté until golden brown.; Add red chili powder and immediately pour the tempering over the cooked lentils.; Stir well and serve hot with the cooked brown rice.
description: Comforting yellow lentils tempered with ghee, cumin, and garlic, paired with fiber-rich brown rice for a complete protein profile.

name: Avocado Salad
ingredients: 1 ripe Avocado (diced); 1 cup Boiled chickpeas; 1 medium Cucumber (chopped); 1 cup Cherry tomatoes (halved); 1 tbsp Olive oil; 1 tbsp Lime juice; Salt and black pepper to taste; Fresh parsley (chopped)
steps: Rinse the boiled chickpeas and place them in a large mixing bowl.; Add the chopped cucumber, cherry tomatoes, and diced avocado to the bowl.; Drizzle olive oil and fresh lime juice over the salad.; Season with salt, black pepper, and fresh parsley.; Toss gently to combine, taking care not to mash the avocado.; Serve fresh or chill in the refrigerator before serving.
description: A refreshing and nutrient-dense vegan salad combining creamy avocados, protein-rich chickpeas, and crunchy cucumbers with a tangy lime dressing.

name: Oatmeal Bowl
ingredients: 1/2 cup Rolled oats; 1 cup Low-fat milk or Almond milk; 1 tbsp Honey; 10 Almonds (sliced); 1/4 cup Fresh blueberries or strawberries; 1/2 tsp Cinnamon powder
steps: In a saucepan, bring the milk to a gentle boil.; Add the rolled oats and reduce the heat to low.; Cook for 5-6 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the oats are soft and the mixture has thickened.; Pour the oatmeal into a serving bowl.; Drizzle honey over the top and sprinkle with cinnamon powder.; Top with sliced almonds and fresh berries. Serve warm.
description: A heart-healthy breakfast option packed with complex carbohydrates, dietary fiber, and healthy fats to fuel your day.

name: Tofu Stir-fry
ingredients: 200g Firm tofu (cubed); 1/2 cup Quinoa; 1 cup Mixed bell peppers (sliced); 1/2 cup Broccoli florets; 1 tbsp Soy sauce (low sodium); 1 tsp Sesame oil; 1 tsp Ginger-garlic paste; 1 tsp Sesame seeds
steps: Rinse quinoa and cook with 1 cup of water in a small pot. Cover and simmer for 15 minutes, then fluff with a fork.; Heat sesame oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.; Add cubed tofu and stir-fry until golden brown on all sides. Remove tofu and set aside.; In the same wok, add ginger-garlic paste, sliced bell peppers, and broccoli. Stir-fry for 4-5 minutes until tender-crisp.; Return the tofu to the wok. Pour soy sauce over the vegetables and tofu, and toss together.; Serve the tofu and vegetable stir-fry over a bed of cooked quinoa, garnished with sesame seeds.
description: A delicious, high-protein plant-based dinner featuring crispy stir-fried tofu and fresh vegetables served over nutrient-packed quinoa.
